APPLICATION_FORM.name: Visa Application Form
APPLICATION_FORM.description: Completed and signed Schengen visa application form
APPLICATION_FORM.notes: Must be completed and signed; a minor’s form is signed by a parent or legal guardian. Anyone included in your travel document submits their own separate form.

PASSPORT_CURRENT.name: Current Passport
PASSPORT_CURRENT.description: Valid passport with at least 3 months validity beyond return date
PASSPORT_CURRENT.notes: Must have at least 2 blank pages and have been issued within the previous 10 years

PASSPORT_PREVIOUS.name: Previous Passports
PASSPORT_PREVIOUS.description: Previous passports with Schengen visas if applicable

PHOTOS.name: Biometric Photograph
PHOTOS.description: Photograph meeting the international travel-document standard (ICAO 9303)
PHOTOS.notes: Check the instructions for the consulate handling your application for any additional photograph requirements.

ID_CARD_COPY.name: National ID Card Copy
ID_CARD_COPY.description: Copy of national identity card (both sides)

TRAVEL_INSURANCE.name: Travel Medical Insurance
TRAVEL_INSURANCE.description: Travel insurance with minimum 30,000 EUR coverage
TRAVEL_INSURANCE.notes: Must cover medical expenses, hospitalization and repatriation — including repatriation in case of death — be valid throughout the Schengen area, and cover your entire stay

TRANSPORT_RESERVATION.name: Round-trip Transport Reservation
TRANSPORT_RESERVATION.description: Flight or other transport booking showing entry and exit
TRANSPORT_RESERVATION.notes: A booking confirmation is normally accepted; the consulate may still ask for more

TRANSPORT_MEANS_PROOF.name: Proof of Intended Means of Transport
TRANSPORT_MEANS_PROOF.description: Other evidence of the transport you intend to use
TRANSPORT_MEANS_PROOF.notes: The harmonised list accepts this in place of a reservation or a travel itinerary

ACCOMMODATION.name: Accommodation Reservation
ACCOMMODATION.description: Hotel booking or other proof of accommodation

DE_OFFICIAL_UNDERTAKING.name: Official Undertaking
DE_OFFICIAL_UNDERTAKING.description: An official undertaking submitted in place of accommodation evidence

EMPLOYMENT_LETTER.name: Employment Letter
EMPLOYMENT_LETTER.description: Letter from your employer, addressed to the consulate you are applying to, stating your name and passport number, start date and role, the employer’s contact details, and the name and position of the person who signs it

APPROVED_LEAVE.name: Approved Leave Letter
APPROVED_LEAVE.description: Approval of leave, addressed to the consulate you are applying to, stating its length and whether it is paid or unpaid, and the name and position of the person who signs it

PAYSLIPS.name: Recent Payslips
PAYSLIPS.description: Salary slips for the last three months

SOCIAL_SECURITY.name: Social Security Documents
SOCIAL_SECURITY.description: SGK employment-entry statement and SGK registration and service document
SOCIAL_SECURITY.notes: Both must carry a readable QR code

BANK_STATEMENTS.name: Bank Statements
BANK_STATEMENTS.description: Bank statement showing movements over the last three months
BANK_STATEMENTS.notes: Should prove the source of a regular income

SPONSOR_LETTER.name: Sponsorship Letter
SPONSOR_LETTER.description: Letter from sponsor declaring financial support

SPONSOR_BANK_STATEMENTS.name: Sponsor Bank Statements
SPONSOR_BANK_STATEMENTS.description: Sponsor bank statements covering the last three months

SPONSOR_INCOME_PROOF.name: Sponsor Income Documents
SPONSOR_INCOME_PROOF.description: Proof of sponsor income (payslips, tax returns)

PREVIOUS_VISAS.name: Previous Schengen Visa Copies
PREVIOUS_VISAS.description: Copies of previous Schengen visas if applicable

EMPLOYER_TRADE_REGISTRY.name: Company Registration
EMPLOYER_TRADE_REGISTRY.description: Chamber of commerce registration and a copy of the trade register bulletin
EMPLOYER_TRADE_REGISTRY.notes: Required if you own the company

PROPERTY_DEED.name: Property Ownership Documents
PROPERTY_DEED.description: Proof of property ownership if applicable
PROPERTY_DEED.notes: Can strengthen ties to home country

TAX_RETURNS.name: Tax Returns
TAX_RETURNS.description: Recent tax returns for self-employed applicants

STUDENT_CERTIFICATE.name: Student Certificate
STUDENT_CERTIFICATE.description: Student certificate; in higher education, issued by YÖK with a readable QR code

CIVIL_REGISTRY_EXTRACT.name: Civil Registry Extract
CIVIL_REGISTRY_EXTRACT.description: Complete extract of the civil registry (Tam Tekmil Vukuatlı Nüfus Kayıt Örneği)

FILING_COUNTRY_RESIDENCE_PERMIT.name: Türkiye Residence Permit
FILING_COUNTRY_RESIDENCE_PERMIT.description: Proof that you reside lawfully in Türkiye, valid for at least three months beyond the date you return from your trip
FILING_COUNTRY_RESIDENCE_PERMIT.notes: Asked of applicants who are not Turkish nationals

DE_S54_DECLARATION.name: Residence Act § 54 Declaration
DE_S54_DECLARATION.description: Signed declaration submitted with the application form, required under § 54 of the German Residence Act
DE_S54_DECLARATION.notes: It records that you have been informed that false or incomplete statements in a visa procedure carry consequences under § 54(2) no. 8 of the Residence Act. The mission provides the wording.

DE_TRAVEL_HISTORY_COPIES.name: Copies of Visas from the Last 10 Years
DE_TRAVEL_HISTORY_COPIES.description: One photocopy of each Schengen, EU, United Kingdom, United States or Canadian visa valid within the last 10 years, and of the passport that carries them
DE_TRAVEL_HISTORY_COPIES.notes: This is separate from your current passport: it covers the pages of any passport holding those visas, including an expired one.

FARMER_CERTIFICATE.name: Farmer Certificate
FARMER_CERTIFICATE.description: Farmer certificate issued by a chamber of agriculture
FARMER_CERTIFICATE.notes: Required if you are a farmer.

request-employer-docs.name: Request employer documents
request-employer-docs.description: Request employment letter, leave approval, and payslips from HR

obtain-bank-statements.name: Obtain bank statements
obtain-bank-statements.description: Get recent bank statements from your bank

purchase-insurance.name: Purchase travel insurance
purchase-insurance.description: Buy travel medical insurance meeting Schengen requirements

confirm-reservations.name: Confirm reservations
confirm-reservations.description: Finalize and print transport and accommodation reservations

final-review.name: Final dossier review
final-review.description: Review all documents, make copies, organize dossier

request-employer-company-docs.name: Request employer company documents
request-employer-company-docs.description: Request company tax plate, trade registry, and signature circular if required

gr-mfa-general.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs — visa information
gr-mfa-general.notes: General ministry entry point carried over from an earlier version of this template. It has not been checked against a current document list.

eu-visa-code-art12.title: Visa Code, Article 12 — Travel document
eu-visa-code-art12.notes: Sets the passport conditions: validity extending at least three months past the intended departure, at least two blank pages, and issue within the previous 10 years.

eu-visa-code-art13.title: Visa Code, Article 13 — Biometric identifiers
eu-visa-code-art13.notes: Requires the photograph to meet the international standards set out in ICAO document 9303 Part 1, 6th edition. It states no number of photographs, no dimensions, no background colour and no maximum age.

eu-visa-code-art15.title: Visa Code, Article 15 — Travel medical insurance
eu-visa-code-art15.notes: Sets the EUR 30,000 minimum cover, what it must include (repatriation for medical reasons, urgent medical attention and emergency hospital treatment), and that it must be valid throughout the territory of the Member States for the entire period of the intended stay.

eu-visa-code-annex2.title: Visa Code, Annex II — Non-exhaustive list of supporting documents
eu-visa-code-annex2.notes: Lists documents a consulate may request. It is explicitly non-exhaustive, so it shows what is accepted, never what is sufficient.

eu-visa-code-art11.title: Visa Code, Article 11 — Application form
eu-visa-code-art11.notes: Requires a completed, signed application form as set out in Annex I; a minor’s form is signed by a person exercising parental authority or guardianship.

gr-tr-harmonised-list.title: List of supporting documents for short stay visas in Turkey
gr-tr-harmonised-list.notes: The Greek mission's publication of the harmonised list for Türkiye, retrieved first-hand on 7 September 2026. Its text is identical to Commission Implementing Decision C(2021) 5156, Annex III, which this pack also cites directly — so the mission adds nothing to the instrument through this document, and anything a Greek applicant faces beyond it comes from elsewhere.

gr-mfa-tr-visa-page.title: Greek Embassy in Ankara — visa information
gr-mfa-tr-visa-page.notes: The consular page for applications lodged in Türkiye, retrieved first-hand on 7 September 2026 after earlier attempts were refused with HTTP 403. It states what to submit: a completed and signed application form, a passport with at least two blank pages issued within the previous ten years and valid three months beyond departure, a recent photograph conforming to ICAO standards, fingerprints where the VIS holds none from the previous 59 months, and the visa fee — then links the supporting-document list. Its insurance paragraph adds emergency medical care, hospitalisation and repatriation including in case of death, EUR 30,000 minimum, valid across the Schengen area for the whole stay.

eu-c2021-5156-turkey-annex3.title: Commission Implementing Decision C(2021) 5156 — supporting documents for short stay visas in Turkey
eu-c2021-5156-turkey-annex3.notes: Annex III to Implementing Decision C(2011) 7192, as amended on 29 July 2021. Adopted by the European Commission under Visa Code Article 14(5a) for the Türkiye jurisdiction, so it applies to applications lodged in Türkiye whichever Schengen state they are for. Article 14(3) leaves the list non-exhaustive: an individual mission may ask for more, and several do. Retrieved from a member state ministry’s published copy of the act.

de-tr-tourism-checklist.title: German missions in Türkiye — tourist visa checklist
de-tr-tourism-checklist.notes: Lists the documents every applicant submits and then the additional documents by applicant category: employees and civil servants, farmers, company owners and self-employed, students, minors under 18, and non-Turkish nationals. Retrieved verbatim on 7 September 2026. Details it states that this pack does not yet render: the employer letter must be the original prepared by the employer in Türkiye; the civil-registry extract must carry an e-Devlet barcode or QR code; the chamber registry copy may come from the chamber of commerce or of industry and must be no older than six months; the social-security records must carry an e-Devlet barcode or QR code and comprise both the employment declaration and the service record; accommodation proof is not required if an official undertaking is filed; and where a pension is relevant it asks for the last three months of pension payment records.

de-tr-schengen-general.title: German missions in Türkiye — general Schengen visa information
de-tr-schengen-general.notes: The page the checklist links for the passport, the photograph and the insurance. It states one photograph of 35 x 45 mm, not older than six months, full-face with nothing covering the head or eyes; a passport issued within the previous ten years with extensions not accepted, valid three months beyond the return and with two blank pages; and insurance of at least EUR 30,000 covering the first intended stay, submitted as the original plus a copy, not retroactive-only, with no age-based coverage limit, for which an AT11 form is not sufficient. The mission also states that in principle only the documents listed in its information sheets are required.

de-aufenthg-54.title: Residence Act, § 54 — Interest in expulsion
de-aufenthg-54.notes: Subsection (2) no. 8 makes false or incomplete statements in a Schengen visa procedure a serious interest in expulsion, and point (b) applies only where the person was informed of those consequences beforehand. It is the basis the declaration refers to; it does not itself list a document to submit.

greece.nationalityVaries: Requirements may vary based on your nationality and the visa centre processing your application.
greece.visaCentre: Applications for Greece are handled by an authorized visa centre in many countries.
greece.peakSeason: Appointment slots may be limited during peak travel seasons.

PHOTOS.size: 35 x 45 mm, and not older than six months
PHOTOS.pose: Full-face, with nothing covering the head or the eyes. Exceptions are possible on religious grounds, but the eyes must stay uncovered

PASSPORT_CURRENT.extension: Issued within the previous ten years — an extended passport is not accepted

TRAVEL_INSURANCE.originalAndCopy: Submit the original policy, which is returned to you, together with a copy
TRAVEL_INSURANCE.notRetroactive: A policy that only reimburses costs after you return home is not sufficient
TRAVEL_INSURANCE.noAgeLimit: It must carry no age-based limit that drops cover below the minimum — often applied from age 65
TRAVEL_INSURANCE.at11: An AT11 form is not sufficient

CIVIL_REGISTRY_EXTRACT.edevlet: Obtained through e-Devlet, carrying its barcode or QR code

SOCIAL_SECURITY.edevlet: Obtained through e-Devlet, carrying its barcode or QR code
SOCIAL_SECURITY.bothDocuments: Both documents are asked for: the employment declaration and the service record

EMPLOYMENT_LETTER.original: The original letter, prepared by your employer in Türkiye

APPROVED_LEAVE.original: The original letter, prepared by your employer in Türkiye — the mission asks for one letter carrying both this and the employment details

EMPLOYER_TRADE_REGISTRY.chamberAndAge: A copy from the chamber of commerce or of industry, no older than six months
